controls.negative: each countermodel rejected by its axiom's verifier

notes: Discrimination matrix (countermodel -> axiom groups whose verifiers fire): K1 -> ['K1', 'K4']; K2 -> ['K1', 'K2']; K3 -> ['K3', 'K4']; K4 -> ['K4']; K5 -> ['K5'].  Where more than the targeted group fires the axioms are entangled in the construction, not the verifier: a non-bar-invariant basis also breaks orthonormality (I_{a,a} = q^{2a_1^2}), an anti-automorphism rho breaks I_{a,a} for a_1 != 0, a q-scaled unit breaks the bar symmetry of the pairs (1, b).  K4 and K5 are isolated: the doubled trace fails orthonormality alone, and on the degenerate torus the even flavour trace fails rho-equivariance alone, so K5 is independent of K1-K4 as a statement about flavoured algebras.

checks.name: transcription K1 (ax:bar): bar involution: antimultiplicative, q -> q^{-1} <-> verify_bar_involution
checks.note: C^c_{ab}(q^{-1}) = C^c_{ba}(q) on every pair of the window (structure constants of the canonical basis)

checks.name: transcription K2 (ax:basis): canonical basis of bar-invariant elements including 1 <-> verify_identity_in_basis / verify_unit_law / verify_associativity
checks.note: 1 is a basis label and a two-sided unit; products of basis elements are Z[q^{±1}]-combinations of basis elements (closure: every product label is a label); bar-invariance of the basis is K1's statement on the structure constants

checks.name: transcription K3 (ax:rho): algebra automorphism rho permuting the basis <-> verify_rho_is_automorphism / verify_rho_inverse / verify_rho_fixes_identity
checks.note: rho(L_a L_b) = rho(L_a) rho(L_b); rho^{-1} rho = id; rho(1) = 1

checks.name: transcription K4 (ax:trace, eq:orthonormality): rho^2-twisted trace with I_{a,b} = Tr L_{rho(a)} L_b = Tr L_b L_{rho^{-1}(a)} = delta_{a,b} + O(q) <-> verify_rho_twisted_trace / verify_trace_pairing_faces / verify_orthonormality
checks.note: Tr(L_a L_b) = Tr(rho^2(L_b) L_a); the two faces agree; I_{a,b} has no negative q-powers and I_{a,b}[q^0] = delta_{a,b}

checks.name: transcription K5 (ax:rhotr): Tr L_{rho(a)} = Tr L_a (hence I_{b,a} = I_{a,b}) <-> verify_trace_intertwines_rho / verify_pairing_rho_star_symmetric
checks.note: Tr(L_{rho(a)}) = *(Tr L_a) and I_{b,a} = *(I_{a,b}), * the identity on Z[q^{±1}] (the rep-ring duality with flavour)
